title: BADLANDS GRAND OPENING — OCTOBER 16
summary: The gates to Badlands open Friday, October 16 at 8:00 PM Eastern Time! Be there for the launch of our newest DayZ server.
content:
SURVIVORS, THE WAIT IS ALMOST OVER!

Beyond the Outbreak is opening the gates to our brand-new Badlands server on Friday, October 16, 2026, at 8:00 PM Eastern Time (EDT).

A new map. A new beginning. A fresh chance to carve out your place in the wasteland. Whether you are a veteran of Beyond the Outbreak or joining us for the first time, we want to see you there for opening night.

The server is scheduled to go live at 8:00 PM. Keep an eye on our Discord and Badlands server page for connection details and any launch updates.

Survive. Adapt. Overcome.
— Beyond the Outbreak Administration

title: Deer Isle Wipe — October 15 at 4:30 PM ET
summary: Deer Isle is scheduled for a wipe on October 15, 2026, at 4:30 PM Eastern Time for the DayZ 1.30 update.
content:
Attention, survivors!

The Beyond the Outbreak Deer Isle server is scheduled for a wipe on Thursday, October 15, 2026, at 4:30 PM Eastern Time (EDT), in preparation for the DayZ 1.30 update.

Please plan accordingly and expect downtime while the wipe and update are carried out. We'll announce when the server is ready for players to return.

Thank you for being part of Beyond the Outbreak. See you on the other side!

title: News & Events Headquarters Is Live
summary: Your new HQ for Beyond the Outbreak updates, server announcements, event schedules, and patch notes.
content:
Welcome to the Beyond the Outbreak News & Events hub. This is where community announcements, scheduled events, maintenance notices, and patch notes will be published.

For discussion and player support, join our Discord community.

title: Deer Isle Field Guide Is Available
summary: Find survival advice for dangerous AI encounters, medical systems, blood types, house materials, and more.
content:
The Deer Isle Tips & Tricks resource includes Terje medicine and skills references, an AI detection radio guide, blood compatibility, House A–G and RaG Hunting Cabin build costs, and survival advice for new players.

Visit the complete field guide before your next run.

title: One Rulebook for Every Server
summary: The official Beyond the Outbreak rules are now organized in one place for Deer Isle and Badlands.
content:
Both Deer Isle and Badlands use the same community-wide rulebook. Please review the full rules before joining.

Players must also react to the final rules message in Discord to acknowledge they have read the current rules.

title: Badlands Opening Date Confirmed
summary: The Badlands server launches Friday, October 16, 2026 at 8:00 PM Eastern Time. Opening day is officially on the calendar!
content:
The countdown to Badlands is on! Beyond the Outbreak will open its Badlands server Friday, October 16, 2026, at 8:00 PM Eastern Time (EDT).

Visit the News & Events page for full opening day details and follow our Discord for updates.
